from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_competing_causes_joint_cases_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有请求记录，不重复：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
proto=readj(OUT/'protocol.json')
selection=readj(OUT/'六固定官方定位实际结果与五原载体选择.json')
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
assert selection['actual_queries']==6
targets=selection['selected_raw_carriers']
assert len(targets)==5<=proto['source_fetch_policy']['primary_raw_GETs_max']
assert len({(t['economic_period'],t['role']) for t in targets})==len(targets)
assert not (OUT/'五原载体首次取得回执.json').exists()
sources=OUT/'sources';assert not sources.exists();sources.mkdir()
cutoffs={x['economic_period']:datetime.fromisoformat(x['same_existing_decision_time']) for x in proto['fixed_cases']}
save('首次取得开始登记.json',{'started_at':now(),'protocol_sha256':sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),'actual_selection_sha256':sha(OUT/'六固定官方定位实际结果与五原载体选择.json'),'actual_raw_GETs_to_start':5,'retries':0,'authentication':0,'new_model_fits':0})
def fetch(t):
 tag=t['economic_period']+'_'+('原价格' if t['role']=='NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE' else '原原因解读')
 rec={'economic_period':t['economic_period'],'role':t['role'],'url':t['url'],'method':'GET','attempt':1,'retry':False,'authentication':0,'started_at':now()}
 try:
  response=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=(12,30),allow_redirects=True)
  rec.update({'status_code':response.status_code,'final_url':response.url,'redirect_urls':[r.url for r in response.history]})
  response.raise_for_status()
  assert (urlparse(response.url).hostname or '').endswith('stats.gov.cn'),'离开原官方范围'
  path=sources/(tag+'.html');path.write_bytes(response.content)
  response.encoding=response.apparent_encoding or 'utf-8'
  soup=BeautifulSoup(response.text,'html.parser')
  alltext=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
  candidates=soup.select('.TRS_Editor,.TRS_PreAppend,.content')
  best=max(candidates,key=lambda z:len(z.get_text(' ',strip=True))) if candidates else soup.body
  text=best.get_text('\n',strip=True) if best else ''
  compact=re.sub(r'\s+','',text)
  headings=[r.get_text(' ',strip=True) for r in soup.find_all(['h1','h2'])]
  expected=t['expected_clock']
  own_clock=expected in re.sub(r'\s+',' ',alltext)
  title_ok=re.sub(r'\s+','',t['original_title']) in re.sub(r'\s+','',alltext)
  original_clock=datetime.strptime(expected,'%Y/%m/%d %H:%M').replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai'))
  before=original_clock<=cutoffs[t['economic_period']]
  month={'2020M10':'2020年10','2021M07':'2021年7','2024M04':'2024年4'}[t['economic_period']]
  required=('工业生产者出厂价格' in compact and '工业生产者购进价格' in compact and '附注' in compact) if t['role']=='NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE' else ('PPI' in text and month in compact)
  tables=[]
  for idx,table in enumerate(best.find_all('table') if best else []):
   rows=[]
   for ridx,row in enumerate(table.find_all('tr')):
    cells=[{'text':c.get_text(' ',strip=True),'rowspan':c.get('rowspan'),'colspan':c.get('colspan')} for c in row.find_all(['th','td'],recursive=False)]
    if cells:rows.append({'row_index':ridx,'native_cells':cells})
   tables.append({'native_table_index':idx,'native_rows':rows,'table_text':table.get_text('\n',strip=True)})
  parsed={'economic_period':t['economic_period'],'role':t['role'],'url':t['url'],'source_path':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_sha256':sha(path),'current_receipt_at':now(),'headings':headings,'own_expected_publication_clock':expected,'own_publication_clock_found':own_clock,'publication_at_Asia_Shanghai':original_clock.isoformat(),'same_existing_decision_time':cutoffs[t['economic_period']].isoformat(),'own_clock_not_after_original_cutoff':before,'title_original_period_identity_pass':title_ok,'complete_body_and_native_notes_identity_pass':required,'own_original_source_qualified':bool(own_clock and before and title_ok and required),'article_text':text,'all_visible_text':alltext,'native_tables':tables,'body_candidate_count':len(candidates),'best_body_selection':'Longest actual original content container, all HTML and visible text also preserved','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'financial_labels_read':False,'new_model_fits':0}
  (sources/(tag+'_原全文表及自身公开钟.json')).write_text(json.dumps(parsed,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
  (sources/(tag+'_原全文.txt')).write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
  rec.update({'completed_at':now(),'status':'GET_COMPLETED_FULL_ORIGINAL_SOURCE','source_path':parsed['source_path'],'source_sha256':parsed['source_sha256'],'bytes':len(response.content),'own_source_qualified':parsed['own_original_source_qualified'],'parsed_full_record':(sources/(tag+'_原全文表及自身公开钟.json')).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
  return rec
 except Exception as exc:
  rec.update({'completed_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)})
  return rec
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:receipts=list(pool.map(fetch,targets))
save('五原载体首次取得回执.json',{'completed_at':now(),'requests':receipts,'actual_raw_GETs':5,'retries':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'new_models':0,'unqualified_role_not_rescued':selection['unqualified_roles']})
for r in receipts:print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ['redirect_urls','source_path','source_sha256','parsed_full_record']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
